claim: The browser demo sends and saves no scrub input, and the site loads no third-party tracking resources.
where: landing preview, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; record demo and privacy requests; enter a unique sentinel, scrub it, reset the sample; assert no URL or request body contains it, only same-origin resources load, and local/session/IndexedDB/Cache Storage contain no sentinel

claim: A returned license is saved locally and verified with Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept the documented Sociobot verification endpoint; load a fixture return token; assert query removal, local token/verdict storage, and the one expected endpoint

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; activate service worker; clear HTTP cache; set offline; reload and scrub new input

claim: casefile demo creates a real casefile from two bundled sample files.
sandbox: run the CLI demo from a clean checkout; assert two inputs, at least seven redactions, and an output archive

claim: Built-in rules replace private keys, URL and header credentials, quoted assignments, JWTs, emails, and IPv4 addresses.
sandbox: pack representative config; decrypt entry and manifest; assert every seeded built-in class is absent and counted

claim: The CLI writes encrypted ZIP entries and a value-free redaction manifest.
sandbox: pack seeded input; decrypt file and manifest with the user password; assert raw values are absent

claim: Every casefile ZIP entry uses AES-256 encryption.
where: landing workflow and pricing, CLI help, README
sandbox: pack seeded input; inspect every ZIP entry's AES metadata and assert Aes256

claim: The CLI reads archive passwords from an environment variable, not a password command-line argument.
sandbox: inspect pack help; assert --password-env exists and no --password argument is accepted

claim: --json returns a machine-readable object for success, validation, and parse errors.
sandbox: invoke successful, validation-failure, and parse-failure pack commands with --json; parse each stdout object and assert empty stderr

claim: The CLI exits 0 on success, 2 for invalid input, and 1 for runtime failure.
sandbox: run successful, missing-input, and unwritable-output commands; assert exact process exit codes

claim: Project-owned JSON rules can replace a named value while preserving its context.
sandbox: pack sample with documented tenant rule; decrypt and assert only the named capture changed

claim: Repeated values receive the same case-scoped token, while another case uses a different token.
sandbox: scrub repeated and distinct emails in two cases; compare same-case and cross-case tokens

claim: A failed pack preserves an existing output and leaves no temporary archive.
sandbox: seed an existing archive; run pack without --force; compare bytes and directory entries

claim: The MIT package exposes one CLI binary.
sandbox: read Cargo package metadata and assert the MIT license plus the only binary target is casefile

claim: The CLI contains no network or telemetry client.
sandbox: inspect clean Cargo metadata and CLI source for network and telemetry clients

claim: The $19 one-time team pack downloads four listed policy starters and a team review checklist after a cached valid license.
sandbox: seed a current valid verdict; assert price and checkout copy, then inspect the downloaded JSON rule names and checklist

claim: The landing page includes a self-hosted recording of the real casefile demo command.
sandbox: load the landing page; assert the labelled SVG recording is served from the same origin
